name: llama.cpp issue #26663: Vulkan token generation 5-7x slower than HIP on gfx1201 for models with hidden_size >= 4096
notes: Clean llama-bench matrix with effective bandwidth computed from file size: 424 GB/s at hidden 2560 vs 67-98 GB/s at hidden 4096/5120, on a 640 GB/s card. Same files run at full speed on the HIP build, ruling out the GGUF itself.
